'''Rezzus''' was an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Village}} during the [[Raffle of the Century]] event.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" |First interaction during [[Raffle of the Century]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy &bSkyBlock Year [year]&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To celebrate this &5&lEPIC &fmilestone, we are organizing a set of &d&l&oCRAZY &fraffles!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: But first, you need a &bTEAM&f!}}
|-
| class="ct" |Closing interface before joining team
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Oh... did you mean to close that?
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: It's fine, click me again!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Joining a team
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Sweet, the &l[COLOR] &fteam.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: I hear it might be the best one!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Anyway... there are &63 &fkinds of raffles going on.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &6Speed Raffles &fare drawn every &92 &fhours.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &bDaily Raffles&f, they happen every &624 &fhours.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &c&lThe Big One&f, which is going to be drawn at the end of &bYear [year]&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To participate, collect &bRaffle Tickets &fand &dslices of cake &fby simply playing &aSkyBlock &fduring the event.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: All tickets you gain are automatically entered into the next raffle of each type.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: When you receive a &dslice of cake&f, it will be a certain &cc&6o&el&ao&9r&f, which corresponds to a certain team.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: There are slices of &cRed Velvet&f, &9Blueberry&f, &eLemon Cheesecake&f, &aMatcha&f, and &dStrawberry Shortcake&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: If you take your slice of cake and feed it to a member of that team, you'll both get some &6rewards&f, in addition to &9bonus Raffle Tickets&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Here, I'll give you &b3 Raffle Tickets &fto get you started.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can get more tickets by eating cake and completing &bRaffle Tasks&f. Check out the &6Raffle Box &ffor more info on those!
&6&lREZZUS GIFT! &eYou gained &b+3 Raffle Tickets&e!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Tada!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can click on the &6Raffle Box &fnext to me or in your &aSkyBlock Menu &fto view your event progress.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Oh, one last thing! The team that enters the most tickets into &c&lThe Big One &fwill receive a special &cmemento &fat the end of the event!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Have fun! You can come speak to me again if you have any questions!}}
|-
| class="ct" |Subsequent interactions
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hello again! &dHappy Century Celebration&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: What would you like to know about the event?
&eSelect an option:
&e➜ &b[How do I enter the raffles?]
&e➜ &6[Which team am I on?]
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Selecting {{Rmt|&b[How do I enter the raffles?]}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To enter a &6raffle&f, you need to collect &bRaffle Tickets&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You will gain tickets just for &ebeing online &fduring the event&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: However, you will gain a bit more if you're actively playing, especially from doing &bRaffle Tasks&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Tickets are not physical items, so don't worry about losing them!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Each time you find a &bticket&f, it will be entered into &lEVERY&f upcoming raffle.
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Selecting {{Rmt|&6[Which team am I on?]}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: For this event, you are on the &7&l[COLOR]&f team!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can tell what team someone is by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in chat.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Or, by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in the TAB list.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: If they don't have a cake emblem, then they haven't gotten involved in the event yet...
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Which means more cake for the rest of us!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Missing the Raffle of the Century
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hi!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: There was a big event in celebration of the &bSkyBlock Year [year]&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: It looks like you missed it, but maybe you'll catch the next event!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Before {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 300}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) &bSkyBlock Year 300&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: We're organizing a huge raffle!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Come talk to me once the event starts!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |After the [[Century Celebration]]s of {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 300}}, {{Aqua|400}} and {{Aqua|500}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hi!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: The &dCentury Celebration &fevent is over, but you can still interact with the &6Raffle Box &fto claim rewards you might have missed.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: See you next time!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Before {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 500}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) &bSkyBlock Year 500&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: As part of the &dCentury Celebration&f, we're organizing a &c&lhuge &fraffle!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Come talk to me once the event starts!}}
|-
| class="ct" |During {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 500}} [[Raffle of the Century]], on a {{Gamemode|Bingo}} Profile
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You cannot claim prizes or even view the raffle box on bingo, but you can earn tickets!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Unsurprisingly, you've been assigned to the &7&l[COLOR]&f &rteam!
&7&oYou will now be able to earn tickets on this bingo profile.
}}
|}
